reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "a8f646e430781a3b1707d3bedde8ea4c8cd76e9a: fix: Notifications on-deployed would now be delivered if sync didn't change the health status of the app in a process", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: On-deployed notifications will now be delivered in scenarios where sync completes without changing application health status, whereas previously they were suppressed in such cases.

proposed.statement: Argo CD now delivers on-deployed notifications when a sync operation completes without changing the application's health status.
